subject: c-fo-act
title: C.FO.ACT.------TR.
description: Diagram in EXT.F(II)-10. Note this is a *tree* diagram (not crossing) — structurally distinct: a sparse, focused structure compared to the dense crossings throughout the section. C-FO-ACT (composite focused activism) is the trunk, running through (R)INT (the reality of intention) to TR (transformation). Two lines leave the stretch between C-FO-ACT and (R)INT and so branch from (R)INT: PHY-U-C (physical universe context) → DYM-F (dynamic functionalism), and (R)PART (the reality of participation).
